messages.text: Good morning. If you come this evening, please stop by Calhoun Pharmacy first. They said one bag is ready.
I can do that after work. Do you need bread, greens, or the low-salt soup too?
Greens and the soup, thank you. I wrote my numbers down like Tasha asked.
Keep the paper by the kitchen phone. I will look at it when I get there.
Morning. If they pull you to the desk before lunch, the lamp return from yesterday still has the wrong sticker on it.
I saw it. The screen rang the sale tag but the shelf card was still last week's number.
Exactly. You know where they keep the override sheet better than half the leads, lol.
I'll fix it after I count small appliances. Same old opening shuffle.
You still stopping by Winn-Dixie after close? They had the big bags of meal and hot sauce marked down.
Yes. Need that, greens, and a small sack of rice. Mama asked what I was fixing before Friday.
Get the fresh bunches, not those tired ones by customer service. Lol.
I saw them. I am not serving nobody wilted leaves at the fellowship hall.
Caleb left two lawn chairs in returns with no tag again. I put them behind the desk.
Manager said if that same man circles returns again tomorrow, we call the county number and keep the receipt drawer closed.
I will catch him before opening and walk through the yellow-tag count with him.
That is fine. I just want the store camera saved too, so nobody has to argue from memory.
Show him that drawer correction screen too. He froze when the pennies were off.
Exactly. I can handle a hard return, but not folks yelling by the front doors while we wait.
I wrote down the steps last night. Trying to keep it clean enough that Mrs. Ray notices without me saying much.
Quick help matters. So does having the whole thing recorded and written down clean.
Good morning. If you are opening today, leave before that school traffic starts.
Yes ma'am. Shirt is ironed and I set my badge by the keys last night.
And wipe those shoes before you walk in there. People notice little things.
Already did. Same black pair, no fuss.
I found your daddy's small square in the hall closet. It was wrapped in an old cafeteria towel.
Please set it on the kitchen table. I want to check the edge before I fit those cypress legs.
It still has the Calhoun Timber sticker on the handle. He kept that thing cleaner than his Sunday shoes.
That sounds right. I can hear him fussing if I leave it dull.
You see that clip about the courthouse budget thing? Folks yelling like it was First Take.
I saw enough. Hard to tell who has an actual plan for clinics and roads when everybody is trying to score points.
You still reading those sample ballot notes like homework?
For the small races, yes. I already know where I usually land on the big names, but county stuff needs more checking.
You see that county meeting clip going around? Folks are lighting it up in the comments.
I saw enough. I am going to ask Marcus what he heard before I say anything about it.
Man you always take it offline lol. You still going to the center tomorrow?
If my shift ends clean, yes. Darius has that worksheet waiting and I told Ms. Reed I would sit with him.
You see that 12 min Duval breakdown I sent? Man said the line finally might hold up.
Not yet. I had the Tampa box score open and got pulled into a short clip from Port Charlotte.
Watch mine after. Dude was talking like he was in the locker room lol.
I saved it. I like the ones where they show the play twice instead of hollering for ten minutes.
Water looked low by Neal Landing yesterday. Bring the small weights if you go.
Already in the truck. I may sit below the bridge before work.
Good. I got the thermos and no speeches.
That is the right plan.
River ought to be low enough by first light tomorrow.
I am going before work. Need that bank quiet before I sit in the office.
Bring the red worms. And bring them papers if they still acting like December's return table was counted wrong.
Already printed the SKU sheet. I can own how I sounded and still keep the math straight.
Mama said you took that Selma book back with a receipt tucked in it. Was that library or store?
Library. I still have the one about the sheriff's daughter in Lowndes County, so don't let her give that away.
Bring it Saturday if you finish. Malik's teacher is doing a family tree sheet and he wants to ask about Granddaddy's church stories.
I can bring the old photo folder too. Tell him we go by what Mama remembers, not what somebody guessed on a form.
You still coming in with those count sheets this morning?
Yes. I stopped by the river first and checked the totals again in the truck.
Good. Keep it plain with Mr. Harris. He respects paper more than speeches lol.
Plain is the plan. First line is about my tone, second line is the corrected number.
I saw your yellow pad by returns. You wrote down the vacuum return mess and the empty peg aisle?
Yes. I put the SKU, time, and who had to leave the floor to fix it. Also wrote the towels endcap sold 31 by 4 pm.
Good. Let Rick see the pattern, not just the cleanup after it is already done.
That is the idea. I am tired of solving it quiet and then hearing the front missed the number.
You see Calvin in that courthouse thread? Man wrote a whole sermon under it.
I saw enough. I checked Aunt Lila's cookout photos, saved that folding table listing, and got out.
Lol you never leave fingerprints on there.
Better that way. Send me that Jags clip if it is short.
Did they fuss at you about those home cuff numbers yesterday?
A little. Said keep logging twice a week, less salt, more walking. Nothing new to pick up.
Good. You still doing that truck unload Friday morning?
Yes, just pacing myself and drinking water. I can handle the shift.
They moved you to close Saturday and open Monday. I saw your name on the paper by the desk.
I figured it would change again. I'll do that courthouse stop Tuesday morning before they touch the board.
Good. And don't let them stick you with Sunday too if you already told your mama you were coming by.
Right. I need Monday afternoon clear if I can keep it.
You still coming by Hardee's before open, or should I just meet you at the store?
Store. I put grits on before I left and packed the rest.
Got you. They posted two short evening slots for next week if you want me to point Rob your way.
Please do. I also told myself no socket set until April.
That sofa sale is real. If you want one for that empty front room, I can hold the tag till closing.
Appreciate it. The second room still has boxes and my ironing board, so I better measure first.
Measure the doorway too. Those Pine Street houses have narrow turns lol.
I will. Nobody is waiting on that room tonight, so I can fool with it after work.
That overtime line show up right on your app yet?
It did. Deposit says 2750 for March, so I wrote that at the top of the page before I start subtracting.
Good. Keep the receipts from this week separate. Those little trips will hide from you.
Already clipped them behind the March page. App catches the card swipes, notebook catches the cash ones.
Good morning baby. Are you still coming by after church tomorrow or Monday?
Monday after work is better. I want to put that loose drawer rail back on and cook some okra before I sit down.
That is fine. Bring your little notebook if you need to add up my pharmacy and grocery money.
I will. I slept better when I wrote mine down early instead of doing it in my head after midnight.
That return line about wore me out today. You make it home before that rain started?
Just pulled in. I'm leaving the house still for a while, then checking whether that chair leg set right.
Good. Don't answer store talk tonight. Let those folks wait until tomorrow lol.
That's the plan. I already put the clamps where I can reach them and shut the door behind me.
Son, if you come sit with me this morning, wear the dark pants. The ushers are doing first Sunday colors late.
I can make it. I put the red book in the truck like you asked.
Good. They may ask you to help carry the folding chairs after the meal.
That is fine. I want to hear Sister Mae lead that old hand-clap one anyway.
I found that little blue folder while moving towels. Your first store badge is still in it.
Keep it on the table for me. I want to put the papers in order before they get bent up.
You were proud of that first check. Your daddy said you counted it twice before supper.
It felt good bringing something home that week. I still like knowing the numbers are right.
Water looked decent by the old landing this evening. Not chocolate milk for once.
Good. I may go before work Tuesday if the fog is not too thick.
Same bank we used after school, or you trying that bend past your mama's back fence?
Past the fence. I know where the roots drop off there, and it stays quiet.
Mama's Tuesday slot got moved to 10:40. Also did you ever call about that tooth place?
I called. They said the first look is covered different than the work after it, so I asked them to print the numbers before I pick a day.
Get it in writing. And don't go by that screenshot people are passing around about the new shots.
I know. Send me the clinic page if your office has it. I'm not sharing anything until I see where it came from.
You really going to get that little blue booklet now? About time lol
Clerk said I need the raised-seal paper from here first. Never had a reason to keep one handy.
You coming Saturday? Folks talking about a little game behind the park if the field dries.
Maybe one or two innings. My legs already got plenty from unloading rugs and patio boxes today.
Man you better use it for more than one trip. Send me a pic if you make it to those green hills with the old stone fences.
Bring that old glove then. And don't let Marcus make you chase everything in left.
That one is still a someday thing. I keep looking at the wood shops and the wide open country up there.
I'll bring water and the glove. If y'all start passing that cooler around, leave me out until fish fry day.
Mama said the pharmacy total was more than last month. Can you grab it Tuesday if I schedule her ride for Thursday?
I can get it after work Tuesday. Truck draft hit today, but it is one of the last few.
Do not skip your little Friday transfer trying to cover everybody.
I am not. I can handle Mama's $42 and keep the $75 set aside. Just means groceries stay plain this week.
Mama said the pharmacy total surprised her. Do you need me to move anything around before Friday?
Let me look at my check first. If I come up short I will call you, not make a whole thing of it.
Good. Also did that boy finish his paragraph tonight?
Almost. We got through the first draft at the center. He does better when nobody is rushing him.
You still opening with me? Manager put two pallets by housewares.
I'm coming. Took my reading before coffee and packed oatmeal instead of that sausage biscuit.
Look at you being sensible lol. Holler if you need me on the heavy boxes.
Appreciate it. I felt all right yesterday, so I should be fine if we don't rush.
Marcus stopped by customer service asking if you left that Riverbend envelope in your locker.
Yes. Gray one behind my name tag. It has the ramp money and the March sheet.
I will hand it to him if he comes back. Y'all and those dawn trips, lol.
Appreciate it. We are checking the water Saturday if the rain holds off.
Son, if you come Monday, look in the hall closet for Reverend Bell's homecoming booklet. Your daddy wrote names in the back.
I'll check after work. I want the dates before I finish that courthouse form.
Put our people down plain. Your grandmama was born right here and so was her mama.
Yes ma'am. I'll copy it from the Bible page and not from memory.
Son, if you come Monday, bring that pan you used last time. Sister Elaine asked about the bread from the skillet.
I can bring it. I was going to put a pork shoulder in Saturday night anyway.
Baby, are you still able to come after church Sunday or did the store change you again?
They have me 1 to 10 Sunday now. I can bring groceries Monday after the morning truck is done.
Baby, when you come Sunday, can you bring that blue pan back? I know you cooked enough stew for yourself.
Yes ma'am. I portioned it out already. Freezer is stacked for the week.
Monday is fine. Do not spend extra driving all over if prices are high.
That will stretch farther than chicken. I have greens already washed.
Good. Lock both doors before you leave that house. I worry when you are out late.
I'll keep it close. I already handled the courthouse thing this week, so Monday can just be you and Publix.
Good. I will do rice too, so nobody has to run back to the store after service.
I do. Porch light timer is working now, and I put the spare key back in the kitchen drawer.
Saw that clip from Quincy. Folks in comments wild already.
I do not post on those threads. I just hope they have more than one angle and somebody outside that office looking at it.
You still using that heavy saw from the shed? The one he used to make us hold the other end of boards with no complaining lol
Only for straight cuts. That saw makes me slow down, which is the whole point.
You always go measured lol. But yeah, camera better not cut off right when it matters.
Measured is not the same as ignoring it. Folks had reasons to march after that Minneapolis video.
Man, those Saturdays behind the house were not games. Pine dust everywhere and him checking every corner.
I still check the corners twice before I call a piece done.
River ought to be quiet Saturday. 6:20 at the landing if you want it.
I am in. Need something besides replaying that manager talk from today.
Bring worms and leave the store in the parking lot.
That is the plan. I am doing one puzzle game tonight and turning the screen over.
Mama said you came by still wearing that blue name tag. I thought they changed those years ago.
They did. Mine stays in the locker with the old scan cards. New folks ask what half of it was for.
That sounds like that place. Are you off the front lane tomorrow or still covering everybody?
Floor first, then returns if Denise gets backed up. I already printed the empty-shelf list.
I left that Odetta CD and the Mississippi John Hurt one by customer service. You said your truck player still works.
It does. Those will fit the drive to Mama's tomorrow.
You still want the Staples Singers disc if my cousin finds it?
Yes. That sound sits right with what I grew up hearing on wooden pews.
Mr. Roland is doing the front aisle check tomorrow. He sent two people back last week over badges and wrinkled collars.
Mine is clipped to the hanger. I am not buying anything new, just pressing the gray one.
Good. Customers ask for help faster when they can tell who works there. LOL
Long as it is neat and gets me through returns and the floor, that is enough.
Do you need me to wait on paying you back for the pharmacy items?
No ma'am, you're fine. I marked the 38 in the small book and the app still matches.
All right. I just do not want your lights and rent money crowded.
I paid those first. I'm keeping the rest of March tight.
I put your cards on the kitchen table. Tasha said she can come by Saturday after the boys' practice.
I'll stop after work tomorrow and bring the fish I cleaned. We can keep it simple.
Forty years is not simple to me, son. I still remember that cold rain at Calhoun General.
Yes ma'am. I'll be there before dark.
Bro this video says the urgent care over here is charging folks crazy money for that new test. People mad in the comments.
Send me the original link, not the stitched one. If it's real the county page or the clinic desk will have something plain about it.
You always want the boring version lol.
Boring keeps me from walking in blind. Last time the paper at checkout was the part I wished I had read first.
Ramp group says the water is still ugly by Neal Landing.
I saw that post. Same place had a decent used bait bucket listed, but I am waiting on the price.
Also saw Benny trying to stir folks up under the sheriff story.
I read it and left it sitting. Fish got more sense than that this morning.
River looked decent at lunch. You riding over before sunrise?
Not tomorrow. Keeping the truck parked unless it's work or Mama.
Fair. Bait shop will survive without your five dollars.
Freezer fish and greens will do me better this weekend anyway.
Mama said you were still at the table with papers after supper. Store stuff?
Some of it. I am putting the return steps and stock count sheet in one place for the two young ones.
Good. Also do not pay for that website until you know the schedule. Read the fine print.
I only saved the sample page. The numbers lesson looked useful, but I have not given them money.
Can you swing by her place Monday before work? I moved the clinic ride to 8:20 because my first patient list is stacked.
Monday works. I can get her there and leave the grocery receipt on the table.
Thank you. I am still in Marianna with both kids' school stuff, so I cannot get over there that early.
I will text you once she is checked in.
Mama said you stayed late again. Was that truck still short?
Short on laundry soap and over on small appliances. I wrote the counts before I left so nobody can say it was guessing.
Keep those papers together. When folks ask who can handle more, memory is not enough.
I have them clipped by week. If the March number turns around, I want it clear what changed.
I found that tire place coupon you asked about. Still came to $397.60 with mount and disposal.
That is about what I figured. I can pay it today, but I am moving the Visa grocery run to next Friday.
At least your truck is almost yours for real. Breakfast on me before open if you want.
Appreciate it. I already did the $50 transfer yesterday, so I am leaving that alone.
Son, Mrs. Henry asked if you knew which judges were on that paper from the courthouse.
Tell her I am still reading. I don't just circle the familiar last name anymore.
That is wise. People need to know who remembers the small towns after the signs come down.
Exactly. Health vans, school money, and whether working folks can get heard matter more than the shouting.
You watching the Jags clips or still messing with that dusty chair?
Both later maybe. Right now the car is in the drive so I can sand the seat rails without bumping into it.
Man you got the whole house smelling like old wood again?
Only out by the rolling door. Inside stays clean and nobody is here to complain.
Water's low but clear. I got crickets. You walking down from the bridge or parking by the bend?
Bridge. That little stretch will loosen me up before we sit.
Good. I ain't carrying you back if your knee starts talking.
I put two tablets in my pocket just in case, but I'd rather not use them before breakfast.
River looks decent. Also your Jacksonville man on that channel already mad and it is March.
He gets loud, but he catches the blocking mistakes before the radio boys do.
Bring worms if you come. I am not listening to draft yelling all morning.
Fair. I will finish that one while coffee runs and leave the rest for later.
Wind is wrong for the river today. Saw a Keys charter video though. Clear water looked unfair.
That is the kind of water I want to try once. Flats boat, light tackle, no muddy bank.
You get your papers straight first?
Started them this week. Felt strange writing only Florida addresses on that form.
Mama wants cake Sunday. She said no fuss, but she already asked me if you like caramel icing.
Caramel is fine. Forty just sounds louder than I expected, that's all.
Then let it be loud for one meal. You have been carrying boxes and fixing other people's messes since you were barely grown.
I know. I am not complaining. I just keep looking at the schedule and wondering how long my knees will keep agreeing.
You been taking that pole out early again or just talking about it?
Went twice this week before the store opened. Works better than sitting in the parking lot staring at the doors.
That meeting after the December mess ever get settled?
Settled enough. I said what I needed to say about my voice, then walked him through the return-bin count.
Son, do not forget you told that child you would be there this evening if work lets you.
I have my blue folder in the car. I am going straight to Room 2 after close.
That is good. And if that bill is heavy this month, call me or your sister. We will talk it through.
Yes ma'am. I would rather talk to y'all first and keep my head clear.
Break room got loud after Earl started on that school board clip. You were quiet.
I only said the meeting date was wrong. Then I went back to checking the endcap count.
Good. The register reset video you sent helped customer service this morning, by the way.
No problem. I found it before my lunch chess timer ran out.
Darius starts driving with his permit next month. I told him keep both hands visible and call me before he reaches for anything.
That is what I do too. My last stop on 20 was calm, but you never know which kind of day somebody is having.
I still think about what they did with Ray at that gas station. Searched his whole car and nothing came from it.
That one bothered me. If they write complaints, someone real needs to read them, not just stack paper in a drawer.
You cooking for Mama birthday or y'all ordering trays?
Cooking. She asked for shrimp and grits, and Tasha said bring something green so the kids eat at least one vegetable.
Save me a plate then. Don't let church folks carry off all the pan bread before I get there.
Come on time and you will be fine.
That Tampa kid robbed one at the wall. Clip is all over my feed.
I saw the catch. Same page had a board puzzle under it and I lost fifteen minutes.
You still reading that thick book about the lady who rode the train out of Mississippi? Man you got patience.
Almost done. The footnotes are better than half the story.
You and those squares. Send me the catch though.
Sent. The angle from center field is the one.
Lol. Mama said the quartet from Quincy is singing Sunday. You going or hiding at the river?
I'll sit with her. If they do Father's old song, I'm staying through the benediction.
River looked decent at daylight. You still got that back room clear enough for my rods if we stop by after?
Clear enough against the wall. Rest is storage boxes and that old fan.
Fine. I won't track mud in. Your landlord already side-eyeing that porch?
He just fixed the latch, so I'm keeping it clean. I only need one mug set out anyway.
RBA says the weigh board is at the old pavilion now. Not by the bait fridge.
Good to know. I will probably skip the talking part and just put my name down.
Same. Sit first, talk never.
Meet 5:40 at the bridge pull-off if the fog is not thick.
Opening with you today? Please tell me you checked the endcap counts before Rob starts asking.
I checked them last night and left the sheet by register two. The clearance rack was off by 6.
That is why I asked you. Some folks just make it look neat and hope nobody notices. Lol.
Looking neat is not enough. If my name is on it, I want the count and tags right.
River looks decent if you can get loose after work.
I will see. I packed my old shoes for the bank and my store shirt is hanging in the truck.
Changing in the parking lot again?
River looks low but fishable. You coming or counting socks at daylight?
Counting towels, not socks. We need 18 more from that table by noon, and I am checking the back first.
Only takes a minute. Mama would still fuss if I walked in with river mud on me.
That store got you doing math before coffee.
Math gets noticed better than complaining. I will come by the landing after close if I still have daylight.
River's too high. Breakfast instead?
That works. I need to stop by McClellan's after and pick through their offcuts.
You making that table for your mama's porch?
Yes. Nothing fancy. Tight joints, no wobble, and wood that can take weather. Same rules I grew up hearing.
Mama found your old folder in the cedar chest. Calhoun hospital card, school papers, all that.
Good. Clerk wanted the certified one, but I may need the folder to match everything.
Your address list should be easy. Blountstown, that short Marianna apartment, then Blountstown again.
Exactly. The harder part is deciding whether Savannah comes before the Keys.
You going by Gloria's tomorrow or you already handled it today?
Tomorrow after my shift. She wants me to bring the cuff batteries and check the mail.
Bet. I am still over by Tallahassee this week, but I can call her after the Jags clip drops.
Call before 8 if you can. She goes quiet once the evening service comes on.
River's muddy. Breakfast instead?
Works. I need to drop my registration card copy in the folder with the 2020, 2022, and 2024 papers anyway.
You keep paperwork like a courthouse clerk.
Only because I got tired of showing up ready for the top of the sheet and guessing on the bottom.
Son, if you come Monday, I only need my pressure medicine and a small bag of greens.
I can bring the greens. I'm putting a pot on with beans and tomatoes tonight, so I'll make enough.
That will be fine. Do not run yourself ragged.
I'm alright. Picked up Thursday closing, so I'm just keeping errands on one trip.
Found that picture of us in front of the old gym. You had that flat-top and the busted Nikes lol
Do not send that around. That was tenth grade and I thought I was clean.
Mama said the trail behind the house is open again. Might bring the boys down when the river drops.
Bring them. They can see the bend where Daddy used to set lines if the bank is dry.
Mama's appointment got moved to Thursday at 3:30. Can you still pick up the paper from the clinic?
Thursday is 10 to 7 unless they swap me for freight. I can go first thing if they leave me alone.
That's why I told you to handle your courthouse errand before the line got long. Your board changes too much.
I did. I'm trying not to burn gas twice between here, the store, and Mama's side of town.
River looks calm Saturday. You up for daylight or you too worn out from the store?
Daylight works. Feet tired, but nothing I can't shake off.
Bring water this time. Last trip you were looking at that little cuff app every ten minutes.
I will. Clinic just wants a few more steady mornings written down, then they'll leave me alone awhile.
Baby, when you come Monday, can you pick up my lettuce and the small pack of chicken legs?
Yes ma'am. I'll come after work. I may walk the river road first if my feet are not too tired from the floor.
Do not overdo that knee. Eat something before you take anything from that little bottle.
I know. I still have most of it from last month. I'll bring your groceries before supper.
River may be too high Saturday. You still doing breakfast?
Maybe later. I promised myself one hour with that inventory numbers video first.
You buying it or just looking?
Just looking. Mrs. Ray had me explain three drawer fixes this week, so I want my notes sharper before I spend anything.
Did you ever ask Denise what she meant about the inventory numbers?
Not yet. I typed it out and erased it twice. I am going to ask plain tomorrow instead of carrying it around all night.
Good. Also do not sit on that chess app until 1 again.
Timer is set. I already packed lunch and moved the bill folder off the table, so after one game I am done.
I can cover the first ten minutes if you need to swing by the pharmacy before opening. Just don't leave me with returns all morning lol.
Appreciate it. Pickup says $18 today, so I'm grabbing it now and keeping the receipt with the other March papers.
Good. And that flyer about the stomach bug is at the service desk now. The one from the county, not Facebook.
I'll read that one on break. I still haven't called the dentist back, but I put the quote beside next week's check stub.
Did you catch that cart by juniors? Same two tags peeled back like last month.
Yes. I moved it near the camera and keyed the missing numbers before I left.
Good. Also the tablet says six blenders in back but I only found one box.
I'll recount receiving in the morning. That mismatch has been happening since the spring reset.
Son, the washer man said it may be right at $400 if that pump is bad. Do not let me put you in a bind.
We will see what he says Monday. I can cover that number if it lands there, but I will have to keep next week quiet.
You already do enough. I do not want you using the money you put away on Fridays.
I moved $75 this morning like usual. Truck is down to the last stretch, so I am not touching that unless the washer really needs it.
Did you see Cousin Renee put the homecoming supper time up? I do not know if it changed.
Yes ma'am. It says 5:30 Saturday. I sent it to Tasha and did not write anything under it.
Thank you. People are carrying on under every little announcement now.
I just needed the time. I am checking one used cooler before I close the app.
You really got Muddy Waters, Doc Watson, and that old family quartet playlist all in one queue?
That is a good Friday night mix. Guitar first, then voices that sound like Sunday morning at Mama's.
Lol you never left Blountstown for real.
Some sounds stay with you. Put the Jags clip in there after Track 6.
River road still has that low spot washed out. County crew had cones up before daylight.
Last storm, those deputies kept traffic moving by the bridge better than I expected. Saved folks from making a mess.
Yep. Same badge can be useful at 6am and still need watching at noon.
That is about right. Help fast when trouble is real, records kept clean when power gets used.
Fish early or you tied up with that table?
I can fish. I put the last coat on and left it sitting where the cats can't get to it.
You don't have cats.
Exactly. One good thing about coming home after the floor crowd all day.
Mama said you left the porch table upside down so the glue could set. She wanted to know why you wrote under it.
Just the date and his initials beside mine. Small, underneath.
That will make her quiet for a minute. Make sure it is not too heavy for her to move when storms come.
I kept it sturdy but light. He always said a thing is no good if it makes work harder for the person using it.
For Sunday, Mama said do not buy canned greens. She said you know better.
I already picked up fresh ones and two catfish packs. Cornbread batter can wait until I get there.
Good. I have the kids setting tables after church, so bring serving spoons too.
I will bring spoons, foil, and the big rice pot.
Mama said your light bill jumped. Did you leave that little heater running in the spare room again?
Probably. That room stays closed off, but it gets damp after rain.
Turn it off at night. And don't let Jamal leave his stuff over there for months like last time.
I told him one weekend only. I need the room clear before Mr. Hargrove walks through in April.
I looked at that school board handout. One man talks pretty about parents but nothing about bus routes or lunch staff pay.
That is what I noticed. I can agree with one side on a lot, but I still need details before I mark every line.
Ask about clinic hours too. Mama's friends keep saying they can't get appointments without driving all over.
I wrote that down with wages and county roads. Folks here get speeches, then the money stops before it reaches us.
You still coming up next weekend or you laying low after that tire bill?
Laying low. March page landed at 2250 after the tire and power bill bump.
Oof. At least payday hit?
Yeah, same 2750 deposit. Nobody else to smooth it, so I'm staying close to home.
Did you see the weather tomorrow?
Yeah, rain all day apparently
Just finished that book you recommended
And? Worth it?
Can you remind me to call back tomorrow?
Setting a reminder now
Left my sunglasses somewhere again
Check the car, you always leave them there
printer is jammed again
Try pulling the tray all the way out
just saw the funniest thing at the store
lol what happened
Are you coming to the thing on Friday?
Maybe, depends on work
Did the package arrive?
Yeah it is by the door
Just got home, exhausted
Same, what a day
Did you see the weather tomorrow?
